title: TELUS Digital to Host Agentforce Industry Sessions and Exclusive Events at Hotel Zetta During Dreamforce 2026
summary: TELUS Digital, a Salesforce Agentforce Partner, hosts sessions, demos and events at Hotel Zetta during Dreamforce 2026, Sept 15-16 in San Francisco.
body_markdown:
[TELUS Digital](https://sfpractice.telusdigital.com/) , a Salesforce Summit Level implementation partner, will host a series of exclusive events, content sessions and Agentforce demos at Hotel Zetta during[Dreamforce](https://www.salesforce.com/dreamforce/) , which takes place September 15-17 at the Moscone Center in San Francisco. Located nearby the Moscone Center, TELUS Digital will be[onsite](https://sfpractice.telusdigital.com/dreamforce-2026) at Hotel Zetta for two of the conference's three days (September 15–16), bringing together Salesforce practitioners, industry leaders and enterprise decision-makers for industry-specific insight exchange sessions, hands-on demo stations, private keynote livestream viewing and a full slate of invitation-only networking events.


Enterprise leaders are increasingly moving past the question of whether to invest in agentic AI and into how to get it into production without the governance, data quality and change management gaps that stall deployments before they scale. That gap is where TELUS Digital's Salesforce practice operates day to day, with production deployments already live across a number of industries. Rather than a sales pitch on what agentic AI can do, attendees can connect with TELUS Digital experts at Hotel Zetta to learn more about the specific governance decisions, data readiness work and change management it takes to move from a working pilot to a system running in production. Additionally, with Salesforce's recent acquisition of Contentful poised to bring native, AI-driven content orchestration to Customer 360, TELUS Digital experts at Dreamforce will unpack how organizations can align content and CRM data into a digital experience.


"Every conversation we're having with clients right now has moved past 'should we pilot Agentforce' to 'how do we get this into production without breaking governance, data quality or our teams' trust in it,'" said Will Mayo, Global SVP of Growth at TELUS Digital. "That's exactly what we built our Dreamforce presence around this year. Instead of a single booth on the show floor, we wanted a space where attendees can sit down with the people who've actually done this deployment work, in banking, higher ed, manufacturing and the contact center, and get straight answers about what it takes. If you're an enterprise leader trying to figure out where Agentforce fits in your roadmap, that's the conversation we want to have with you at Hotel Zetta."


### **Key Facts**


- TELUS Digital is a recognized Salesforce Agentforce Summit Level Partner, with more than 40 Agentforce-powered AI agents activated for clients across industries to date


- According to a[Gartner survey](http://gartner.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/2026-02-18-gartner-survey-finds-ninety-one-percent-of-customer-service-leaders-under-pressure-to-implement-ai-in-2026) published in February 2026, 91% of customer service and support leaders reported being under pressure to implement AI in 2026


- TELUS Digital acquired[Gerent](https://www.telusdigital.com/about/newsroom/telus-digital-expands-capabilities-with-addition-of-gerent) in 2025, a U.S.-based Salesforce-focused consultancy that delivers enterprise-scale implementation and integration projects, and agentic AI solution, adding Salesforce Summit-level expertise and deepening the practice's implementation and managed services capabilities


- TELUS Digital's Salesforce practice spans strategy, implementation, data and AI, and digital experience


- TELUS Digital operates across 35+ countries with more than 80,000 team members serving over 600 global brands, training, building, running and protecting AI across key business functions including customer service, marketing and product development


## **Meet TELUS Digital at Dreamforce**


From September 15-16, attendees who visit TELUS Digital at Hotel Zetta can:


- Attend industry insight sessions tailored to financial services, contact center/CX and higher education


- Visit demo and advisory stations running hourly across both days to explore Agentforce, Revenue Cloud, MuleSoft, Contenful, field service and industry-specific solutions


- Watch Dreamforce keynotes, including industry-specific sessions, in a private livestream setting


- Join invitation-only networking events, including happy hours and a concert pre-party with shuttle service


- Recharge with complimentary breakfast, lunch and refreshments throughout the day


- Schedule one-on-one meetings with TELUS Digital's Salesforce practice leaders and specialists


### **Insight exchange sessions**


TELUS Digital will deliver practitioner-led content sessions covering the industries where its Salesforce practice runs deepest: higher education, financial services and contact center/customer experience. Each session is designed to move beyond platform overview and into practical application, pairing TELUS Digital consultants with client and industry leaders to share what real Agentforce deployment looks like in production.


**Tuesday, September 15**


**Session: Where higher ed should start with Agentforce**


**Time: 3:30pm - 4:30pm**


**Location: Reboot Room, Hotel Zetta**


TELUS Digital Senior Consultant, Julia Taylor will lead "Where higher ed should start with Agentforce," addressing how colleges and universities can find high-impact, low-lift entry points for AI agents even when data is fragmented and IT resources are lean. The session draws on TELUS Digital's work with institutions such as Adler University, where TELUS Digital helped resolve Education Cloud challenges and streamline the admissions process to improve the applicant experience. Attendees can register for this session via TELUS Digital’s[event page](https://sfpractice.telusdigital.com/dreamforce-2026/edu-session) .


**Session: Turn your contact center into a revenue engine with AI**


**Time: 3:30pm - 4:30pm**


**Location: Demo Room, Hotel Zetta**


TELUS Digital’s Abby Spahich, Global VP of Digital CX and AI, and Salesforce’s John Robb, Senior Director of Products, Agentforce Contact Center & Voice AI, will lead the session, "Turn your contact center into a revenue engine with AI." They will explore how Agentforce Contact Center addresses the platform fatigue and adoption barriers facing today’s contact centers. The session lands as 91% of customer service and support leaders say they are under pressure to implement AI in 2026, according to a[Gartner survey](http://gartner.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/2026-02-18-gartner-survey-finds-ninety-one-percent-of-customer-service-leaders-under-pressure-to-implement-ai-in-2026) of 321 leaders published in February 2026, with faster resolution, reduced customer effort and stronger self-service among their top priorities. Spahich will walk through a framework for evaluating CCaaS solutions before turning to how Agentforce Contact Center puts that framework into practice. It also demonstrates how to move from the assessment stage to deployment. Attendees can[register](https://sfpractice.telusdigital.com/dreamforce-2026/teluscx-session) for this session via TELUS Digital’s event page.


**Wednesday, September 16**


**Session: Turning AI pilots into tangible production for banks and credit unions**


**Time: 3:30pm - 4:30pm**


**Location: Demo Room, Hotel Zetta**


Most financial institutions have piloted AI, but few have deployed AI agents into full production. This session, led by TELUS Digital's VP of Sales for Regulated Industries, Brendan Nolan, and Consultant, Steve Stevens, brings together technology and business leaders from TELUS Digital's bank and credit union clients to share how they built internal buy-in, navigated implementation and compliance realities, and are now tracking results like deflection rates, handle time, member satisfaction and cross-sell performance, along with where they're taking Agentforce from here. Attendees can[register](https://sfpractice.telusdigital.com/dreamforce-2026/fins-session) for this session via TELUS Digital’s event page.


### **Hands-On Demo Stations**


Running continuously across both days from 8am - 5pm in the S&R Lounge, TELUS Digital will host demo and advisory drop-in stations led by subject matter experts, with new demonstrations starting at the top of every hour. Attendees can bring specific questions, explore use cases relevant to their industry and see working Agentforce solutions firsthand, including:


- **Agentforce & AI across the organization:** see how internal, external and flow-triggered agents work together as a single operating model, led by Consultant, Tim Stewart


- **Revenue Cloud & Field Service:** discover faster, more accurate quoting with Agentforce Revenue Management


- **Manufacturing:** see how Agentforce solves field service inventory visibility and automates warranty/contract pricing on work orders, led by Principal Consultant, Victor Domatz


- **MuleSoft:** learn how Claude AI and MuleSoft Vibes are embedded into developer workflows for automated code review and Anypoint environment audits, led by Systems Principal Architect, Andrew Smith


- **Agentforce Contact Center:** see how Data 360, Marketing Cloud Next and Agentforce turn unified customer data into personalized, real-time engagement, led by Solutions Architect, Bartek Dyczkowski


- **Contentful** : turn real-time signals into a personalized offer, with Contentful keeping the messaging consistent across every touchpoint along the way, led by Marketing Cloud Lead, Debra Cotton


### **Keynote Livestreams and Rest & Recharge**


Attendees can also catch the Dreamforce keynotes without leaving Hotel Zetta. TELUS Digital will livestream the main keynote as well as industry-specific keynotes for financial services, manufacturing and education in a private, comfortable setting with food and beverages. Throughout each day, guests can also step away from the conference floor for complimentary breakfast, lunch and premium refreshments in TELUS Digital's Rest & Recharge space while networking with colleagues, partners, customers and Salesforce leaders.


### **Networking and Happy Hour events**


TELUS Digital will also host a series of private networking events and happy hours. On September 15 from 5–9 pm, TELUS Digital and co-sponsor Quantum Metric will host an executive happy hour with hosted drinks and appetizers. On September 16 from 4–9 pm, a concert pre-party and happy hour, co-sponsored by Contentful, will run alongside a complimentary shuttle service to that evening's Dreamforce concert. Attendees looking for a lighter moment can also stop by TELUS Digital's "Plinko with Purpose" board, where every game played funds the planting of a tree and gives players a chance to win a $50 Amazon gift card.


Space is limited, and separate registration is required for Day 1 and Day 2. To register, visit TELUS Digital’s[event page](https://sfpractice.telusdigital.com/dreamforce-2026?linktype=events-list-item#happy-hours) .


## **Connect with TELUS Digital leaders and product specialists**


Will Mayo, Global SVP of Growth at TELUS Digital, and Gopi Ramineni, Salesforce Practice Leader at TELUS Digital, will both be present throughout the conference and available to meet with attendees. Additionally, Brendan Nolan, VP of Sales, Regulated Industries, Eric Saxton, VP of Sales, Emerging Industries, Abby Spahich, Global VP, Digital CX Practice, and other sales leaders and subject matter experts will also be onsite.


To schedule meetings with TELUS Digital Salesforce experts at Dreamforce 2026, visit TELUS Digital’s[event page](https://sfpractice.telusdigital.com/dreamforce-2026) or contact[\[email protected\]](https://www.telusdigital.com/about/newsroom/charlene.steffanazzi@telusdigital.com) .
